    ```java
    public class StatisticsTracker {
        private final Map<String, int[]> counts = new HashMap<>();
        private final Map<String, Map<String, BigDecimal>> fees = new HashMap<>();

        public void count(String date, int slot) {
            int[] c = counts.computeIfAbsent(date, k -> new int[2]);
            c[slot]++;
        }

        public void addFee(String date, String currency, BigDecimal delta) {
            if (delta.signum() == 0) return;
            Map<String, BigDecimal> m = fees.computeIfAbsent(date, k -> new TreeMap<>());
            m.put(currency, m.getOrDefault(currency, BigDecimal.ZERO).add(delta));
        }

            int ok = c == null ? 0 : c[0];
            int rejected = c == null ? 0 : c[1];
            Map<String, BigDecimal> f = fees.get(date);
            String feeText = "none";
            if (f != null && !f.isEmpty()) {

                }
                feeText = sb.toString();
    ```

    ```java
    package com.rustyledger;

    import java.math.BigDecimal;
    import java.math.RoundingMode;

    public class CurrencyConverter {
        private BigDecimal rate(String currency) {
            if (currency.equals("EUR")) return new BigDecimal("4.30");
            if (currency.equals("USD")) return new BigDecimal("4.00");
            return new BigDecimal("1.00");
        }

        public BigDecimal convert(BigDecimal amount, String from, String to, String tier) {
            BigDecimal inPln = amount.multiply(rate(from)).setScale(4, RoundingMode.HALF_UP);
            BigDecimal result = inPln.divide(rate(to), 4, RoundingMode.HALF_UP);
            if (!"STAFF".equals(tier)) {
                result = result.multiply(new BigDecimal("0.985"));
            }
            return result.setScale(2, RoundingMode.HALF_DOWN);
        }
    }
    ```

    ```java
                BigDecimal fee = amount.multiply(new BigDecimal("0.005")).setScale(2, java.math.RoundingMode.HALF_UP);
                return fee.max(new BigDecimal("0.20"));
    ```
